network.@earendil-works/pi-agent-core: Agent loop that calls model APIs through pi-ai.
network.@earendil-works/pi-mcp: MCP client for remote tool servers.
network.@google/model-viewer: Loads the 3D model a page points it at.
network.@opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-http: Sends traces to an OTLP endpoint.
network.@scalar/client-side-rendering: The API reference page it renders loads its viewer from a CDN.
network.electron-updater: Checks and downloads desktop app releases.
network.html-to-image: Fetches the images and fonts on a captured element to inline them.
network.nodemailer: Sends email through a mail server.
network.playwright-core: Drives a browser that loads web pages.
network.web-push: Sends push notifications through a browser push service.

runtime.@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk: Runs Claude Code; its child environment carries the telemetry-off names.
runtime.@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-darwin-ar: Claude Code binary, run through the SDK above.
runtime.@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk-win32-x64: Claude Code binary, run through the SDK above.
runtime.@openai/codex: Codex binary; its child environment carries the telemetry-off names.
runtime.@openai/codex-darwin-arm64: Codex binary, run through the package above.
runtime.@openai/codex-sdk: Runs Codex; its child environment carries the telemetry-off names.
runtime.@openai/codex-win32-x64: Codex binary, run through the package above.
runtime.@opencode-ai/sdk: Runs OpenCode; its child environment carries the telemetry-off names.

covered.@a2a-js/sdk: packages/a2a-gateway uses only its server and type parts, answering A2A requests; a client call would go through fetch, which is counted.
covered.@modelcontextprotocol/sdk: Mostly servers; its network clients are counted by the client-transport constructor rule.
covered.@ngrok/ngrok-darwin-arm64: Native binary loaded by @ngrok/ngrok, which is listed.
covered.@ngrok/ngrok-win32-x64-msvc: Native binary loaded by @ngrok/ngrok, which is listed.
covered.better-auth: Sign-in; it reaches outside only for social sign-in, counted by the socialProviders rule, and OIDC, counted where fetch is wired.
covered.ws: Mostly WebSocket servers; a client is counted by the new WebSocket rule under any import name.
